text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami? Are you feverish? Have<n>you eaten
anything strange recently?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-no! I didn't eat at all! I'm actually<n>starving right
now!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've been too busy making this really<n>big cake for
your special day—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please, forget everything I just said!<n>If you know
about the surprise, it<n>won't be a surprise!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh nooo! I wanted to be all elegantlike you and lead you to it discreetly,but I ruined it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So you revealed a little surprise or<n>two—why would I
be disappointed by<n>that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You made such an effort to celebrate<n>my birthday...
That's the most<n>wonderful surprise of all.
